en.bdb: The apostate is a big sinner

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਗਾਂਈ ਵੰਸ ਘਾਤ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: baamhan gaa(n)iee va(n)s ghaat aparaadh karaare|

en.bdb: (It is said that) The killing of brahmin, cow and the man of one's own family is a deadly sin.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਦੁ ਪੀ ਜੂਏ ਖੇਲਦੇ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਪਰਨਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: madh pee jooe kheladhe johan paranaare|

en.bdb: The drunkards gamble and look at the wives of others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਨਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਲਛਮੀ ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਚਗਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: muhan paraiee lachhamee Thag chor chagaare|

en.bdb: The thieves and decoits loot other's wealth.
These all are treacherous, ungrateful, sinners and killers.
If such persons are gathered in infinite number;

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਲੂਇ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: eikat looi na pujanee bemukh gurdhuaare ||16||

en.bdb: Even they all are not equal to the single hair of the apostate.
